column3: NKJV has “that he may know your circumstances,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “that you may know our circumstances.”
NKJV has “a great zeal,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “much labor.”
NKJV has “Nymphas and the church that is in his house,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Nympha and the church in her house.”
